terms.gloss: the troops in reserve; support in battle, relief; help, support of any kind
evidence: Caes. BG 2.26: cum alius aliī subsidium ferrent (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 2.7: funditōrēs Baleārēs subsidiō oppidānīs mittit (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: since they were bringing help to one another

phrases.latin: auctus est ibi fīliā, in subsidium simul et sōlācium
phrases.english: there a daughter was born to him, a support and a comfort at once

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
